visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a extreme close-up of a large stainless steel container filled with a thick, pale yellow-green mung bean paste. A metal scooper is firmly pressed into the dense mixture, creating deep grooves and textures. The background shows other similar metal vats and lids in a brightly lit indoor stall. (2) A person's hand, wearing a gold ring, uses a large rounded metal scoop to lift a generous portion of the mung bean paste and transfer it into a clear plastic cup. The texture appears grainy and solid. (3) The cup is being filled continuously; the hand presses the paste down to ensure it is packed tightly. The background is slightly blurred, showing the refrigerator unit of the stall. (4) A close-up shot shows a white plastic spoon lifting a small, smooth dollop of the smoothie, revealing a finer, more liquid texture at the very top. (5) The camera cuts to a different container filled with a deep purple red bean paste. A metal scooper is similarly used to dig into this dense, textured mixture. (6) The red bean paste is scooped into a plastic cup, showcasing its thick and slightly chunky consistency. (7) A finished cup containing only the purple red bean smoothie is held up against a background of the market stall. (8) Two clear plastic cups are shown side-by-side: one with the purple red bean smoothie and one with the yellowish mung bean smoothie, both featuring black brand logos. (9) A hand holds a single cup that is layered: purple red bean paste at the bottom and yellow mung bean paste on top. (10) A woman with her hair in a high bun, wearing a pink t-shirt with a small logo, is seen behind a counter pouring fresh milk from a white carton into a cup already containing the smoothie. (11) A triple-layered drink is held up, showing red bean at the base, mung bean in the middle, and a white milk/foam layer at the top. (12) A close-up shows a spoon stirring the top milk layer into the smoothie, creating a marbled effect with bubbles. (13) Two finished cups of the layered smoothies are held up together in front of the stall. (14) The woman in the pink shirt is seen again, actively scooping paste into cups inside the stall's refrigerated unit. (15) The final shot is a wide view of the stall named '荳神', showing various menus, promotional signs, and the woman working in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male narrator begins speaking in a friendly, enthusiastic tone over a rhythmic, upbeat electronic pop background track. The sound of a metal scooper rhythmically scraping and thumping against a stainless steel container provides a textured, percussive layer to the narration. (2) As the speaker describes the texture of the smoothie, the background music maintains a consistent, driving beat. The vocal pitch is dynamic, often rising at the end of phrases to maintain viewer engagement. Occasional muffled background market noise is present but low in volume. (3) The acoustic texture shifts slightly with the sound of liquid pouring as milk is added, momentarily competing with the narrator's voice. The music's synth pads provide a bright, energetic harmonic bed throughout this segment. (4) The narrator concludes with a call to action, maintaining a high arousal level. The BGM continues until the very end, fading out quickly with a final hard cut as the speaker finishes his last sentence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote a local mung bean and red bean smoothie stall located in a Kaohsiung market. The video uses appetizing close-ups of the food preparation and high-energy narration to highlight the texture, flavor combinations, and value for money, targeting local foodies and summer refreshment seekers.
